_about: The ONE place that says which Raptor version each download is. After publishing a release, edit this file and run:  python scripts/set_release.py   It rewrites every download link and version label on the Raptor pages. Both platforms use the same version number from raptor-ui/package.json, and both files live in the same GitHub release (raptor-dist, tag v<version>). The Windows link goes through the Cloudflare Worker 'raptor-download' (source: release-proxy/worker.js in the desktop repo), which serves the file from that GitHub release with an address that does not expire, so slow downloads finish. Releasing needs no extra upload: publish on GitHub, then change the version number in the URL here.
